name: TOB Sunday School Quiz Assignment
description: Assigns an existing `LMS Quiz` (the same quiz doctype and take/grade flow every app user already uses) to a Sunday School weekly-rewards slot. Taking the quiz and seeing the score stay on the app's regular quiz screens — this row only marks it as Sunday-School-scoped: it disappears from the app-wide public quiz list forever (see api/quiz_visibility.py's permission_query_conditions hook), and its LMS Quiz Submission rows earn Sunday School points via sunday_school/engine.py::on_lms_quiz_submission (a doc_event, see hooks.py). No question-authoring happens here — the quiz content is managed entirely through the existing LMS Quiz admin screens.

fields.label: Quiz Type
fields.options:
Weekly Bible Quiz
Faith Leader Exam
fields.description: Both are the same mechanic (marks convert to points) — this only decides which Student Dashboard slot and which Points Ledger source ("Weekly Quiz" or "Faith Leader Exam") the submission counts under.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only an Active assignment is shown on the Student Dashboard and counts new submissions toward points. Archiving never un-hides the quiz from the public list — see this doctype's own description.
